model: UC400-B / Symbio 500 (FC, BC, UV, staged WSHP) - touch-screen zone sensor points
equipment_type: Heat pump / fan coil controller (zone sensor interaction subset)
applies_to: Factory-programmed Trane fan coils, blower coils, unit ventilators and staged water-source heat pumps on Tracer UC400-B or Symbio 400-B/500, used with the touch-screen programmable zone sensor.
summary: This short list shows which UC400-B / Symbio 500 objects the Trane commercial or residential touch-screen programmable zone sensor reads and overrides on fan coil, blower coil, unit ventilator and staged WSHP units. It covers space temperature, setpoints and offset, heat/cool mode request and status, occupancy request, fan configuration, fan speed and capacity status. The sensor and controller talk BACnet MS/TP.
notes: This is a SUBSET: only the unit-controller objects that the Trane touch-screen programmable zone sensor reads or overrides (Table 3 of BAS-SVP080A). It is not the controller's full points list.
Access is inferred: the doc gives no read/write column. Points the sensor takes over (it writes Out_Of_Service at power-up) are shown as W; the others as R.
The sensor writes its commands at priority 7. A BMS can still write Space Temperature BAS at priority 5 or higher; priority 6 is reserved for minimum on/off.

The sensor objects that map to these points (AV 100, AV 44, AV 43, MV 16, MV 112, MI 33, MV 17, MV 140, MV 172-174) belong to the sensor itself; see the Viconics VT8000 BACnet guide for its full list.
Only factory-programmed controllers are supported; field-programmed UC400-B/Symbio 400-B/500 units are not.
Instances here are the 'UC400 WSHP Object' column of Table 3; VS-WSHP units use different instances (separate entry).

source.title: Touch Screen Programmable Zone Sensor Integration Guide (Tracer UC400-B, Symbio 400-B/500/700/800, ReliaTel)

integration.summary: Use a BMS mainly for monitoring, trending and alarms when the touch-screen sensor runs the unit. The sensor owns occupancy, mode, fan and setpoint commands; read the mode status, fan speed and capacity points, and only write Space Temperature BAS (priority 5 or higher) if the BMS must supply space temperature.

minimum_points.name: Supply Fan Configuration Command
minimum_points.why: Fan mode: Inactive = Auto, Active = On

minimum_points.name: Space Temperature BAS
minimum_points.why: Space temperature in use by the unit

integration.enable: The touch-screen sensor controls the unit: at power-up it sets Out_Of_Service on the occupancy, mode, fan and setpoint objects and writes them at priority 7. The guide recommends leaving control with the sensor and using the BMS for monitoring.
integration.remote_sensors: Space Temperature BAS normally comes from the sensor; a BMS can command it at priority 5 or higher. Space Temperature Local is the unit's hard-wired sensor.
setup: The sensor talks BACnet MS/TP only; default baud 76800. Set Sens. Address (MAC 0-127), Sens. Device ID and Unit Device ID at the sensor (installer password 4017).
Sensor and unit controller should be on the same MS/TP link to reduce communication loss; they can be on different links if both reach the same BACnet network.
Trane best practice device ID: MS/TP network number followed by the rotary/MAC address (e.g. network 11, MAC 001 = 11001).
gotchas: The sensor holds these points Out_Of_Service and writes them at priority 7; a BMS writing the same points will fight the sensor.
Never add MV 5 to a VS-WSHP: the sensor uses the presence of MV 5 to tell a staged unit from a VS-WSHP.
The sensor reads the units property of Space Temperature BAS to decide between °F and °C.
If the wired temperature sensor fails, the sensor's own internal element takes over and is sent to Space Temperature BAS.

points.name: Space Temperature BAS
points.description: Space temperature sent by the touch-screen sensor, -40-150 °F

points.name: Space Temperature Local (TempRemSrc)
points.description: Hard-wired space temperature at the unit, -40-200 °F

points.name: Heat Cool Mode Request BAS
points.description: Heat/cool mode request written by the sensor (default Auto)
points.states: 1=Auto, 2=Heat, 3=Morning Warm-up, 4=Cool, 5=Night Purge, 6=Precool, 7=Off, 8=Test, 9=Emergency Heat, 10=Fan Only, 11=Free Cool, 12=Ice Making, 13=Max Heat, 14=Economy Mode, 15=Dehumidifying, 16=Calibrate

points.name: Heat Cool Mode Status BAS
points.description: Actual heat/cool mode of the unit
points.states: 1=Auto, 2=Heat, 3=Morning Warm-up, 4=Cool, 5=Night Purge, 6=Precool, 7=Off, 8=Test, 9=Emergency Heat, 10=Fan Only, 11=Free Cool, 12=Ice Making, 13=Max Heat, 14=Economy Mode, 15=Dehumidifying, 16=Calibrate

points.name: Occupancy Request
points.description: Occupancy request written by the sensor (default Occupied)

points.name: Supply Fan Configuration Command
points.description: Fan mode: auto or continuous on (default Auto)

points.name: Cooling Capacity Status
points.description: Mechanical cooling, 0-100 %; sensor shows On when > 0

points.name: Heat Primary Capacity Status
points.description: Primary heating, 0-100 %; sensor shows On when > 0

points.name: Heat Secondary Capacity Status
points.description: Secondary heating, 0-100 %; sensor shows On when > 0
